data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 4/6): Add stderr-names-denied-action assertion for dd-5 evidence. Current test 3 asserts exit 5 + zero create-* but not which action was denied. Mirror sibling test-aws-setup-bucket.sh line 245-249 pattern: capture stderr; assert it contains denied action name (e.g., 'lambda:CreateFunction' or 'iam:CreateRole'). Mirror task-2 preflight_iam: stderr must name the specific denied action, not generic 'IAM perms missing'.
